title: Pipe and Plate Templates
objective: Understand the purpose of pipe and plate templates and controlled dimensional information.
safety_boundary: Drawing and template theory only; no hazardous fabrication procedure.

sections.heading: 1. Template purpose
sections.body: Templates transfer controlled shape and dimensional information to fabrication work.

sections.heading: 2. Pipe and plate context
sections.body: Pipe and plate work may require different template forms depending on the specified component geometry.

sections.heading: 3. Dimensions
sections.body: Dimensions and reference information must come from approved drawings or specifications.

sections.heading: 4. Verify
sections.body: Unclear template information must be resolved before practical fabrication proceeds.
